solver: staggered MAC free-surface APIC with incomplete-Cholesky PCG pressure
primary_format: CYBRWTR1: 32-byte header; position, velocity, reference density ratio=1, visual surface activity. .ids holds uint32 IDs; .volumes float32 physical marker volumes in m^3. d is marker spacing, h=2d.
secondary_format: CYBRWW01: 32-byte header {magic[8],uint32 version,count,frame,float time,dx,reserved}; records {float x,y,z,vx,vy,vz,radius,age,lifetime,uint32 type}; type0 spray,1 foam,2 bubble
secondary_scope: Flow-derived visual parcels sharing the liquid MAC velocity and reconstructed surface. They do not remove primary marker mass, do not resolve air pressure, and do not predict the physical spray size spectrum. Isolated primary markers retain their volume.
solid_scope: Shared scene SDF sampled at MAC grid nodes; 4x4 face aperture quadrature; cells with solid centers excluded from pressure. Marker contact uses cached trilinear SDF followed by continuous-scene-field refinement near rocks.
reseed_scope: Within-cell marker splits and volume-weighted merges preserve represented volume and linear momentum to floating-point accuracy; no unrecorded bulk-liquid culling.
checkpoint_scope: CYBRFLP4 native little-endian C++ ABI checkpoint, includes marker volumes and affine matrices, secondary states, pressure warm start, emission debt, IDs and ledgers. A stored executable/configuration/cached-SDF fingerprint rejects incompatible resumes.
